summary_zh: 本页为绘本《霸王别姬》的扉页，展示了书名、作者、绘者、审校者及出版社信息，画面中描绘了项羽骑马的京剧形象，背景为简洁的白色，突出人物造型与文字信息。

page_text_ocr_zh:
风声萧萧，战旗飘飘。
刘邦一路追击项羽大军，来到垓下。他任命韩信为元帅，要与项羽决战。
韩信在九里山设下十面埋伏，让谋臣李左车去项羽营中假意投降，设法将楚军引入埋伏圈。
page_text_en:
The wind howls, and battle flags flutter.
Liu Bang chased Xiang Yu's army all the way to Gaixia. He appointed Han Xin as the commander-in-chief, ready to fight Xiang Yu.
Han Xin set up an ambush of ten sides at Jiulishan, sending his strategist Li Zuoche to pretend to surrender to Xiang Yu's camp, in order to lure the Chu army into the trap.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了刘邦追击项羽至垓下，任命韩信为元帅，并设下十面埋伏，派李左车假意投降以诱敌深入的战前布局场景。

page_text_ocr_zh: 项羽正在为援军迟迟未到的事着急呢，项伯突然进帐，报告李左车前来归顺。项羽一听，心中疑惑：早听说这个李左车足智多谋，若真心归顺，倒是天大的好事！不过，他在这个节骨眼上出现，可能有诈。项羽决定当面试探一下。
page_text_en: Xiang Yu was anxious about the delayed arrival of reinforcements. Suddenly, Xiang Bo entered the tent and reported that Li Zuoche had come to surrender. Upon hearing this, Xiang Yu felt suspicious: He had heard that Li Zuoche was wise and resourceful. If he truly surrendered, it would be a great blessing! However, his appearance at this critical moment might be a trick. Xiang Yu decided to test him personally.
summary_zh: 项羽因援军未到而焦急，项伯报告李左车前来归顺，项羽心生疑虑，决定当面试探。

page_text_ocr_zh:
项羽问：“李左车，你是韩信的谋臣，怎么会突然来归顺我？”
李左车镇定地回答：“大王有所不知，韩信自从被封为齐王以后，
愈发狂妄，听不进半句建议！现在，他手下的谋臣已走了一大半。
所以，我前来投奔，以效犬马之劳。”
项羽冷哼一声：“两国交战，诈降最多，你一定是韩信
派来的卧底！”
李左车一听，假装生气地说：“大王，臣只是一个谋士，真心
想为您出谋划策。如今您不信，我不如一头撞死。”说完，李左车
起身，朝着柱子撞去。
项羽见李左车愿意豁出性命来证明自己，就相信了，立刻将他拦下。
page_text_en:
Xiang Yu asked, "Li Zuochē, you are Han Xin's strategist. How could you suddenly come to surrender to me?"
Li Zuochē calmly replied, "Your Majesty, you don't know. Since Han Xin was made King of Qi, he has become increasingly arrogant and refuses to listen to any advice! Now, half of his strategists have already left. So, I have come to join you, to serve you with all my loyalty."
Xiang Yu sneered, "In war between two nations, deception is common. You must be a spy sent by Han Xin!"
Upon hearing this, Li Zuochē pretended to be angry and said, "Your Majesty, I am merely a strategist, sincerely wishing to offer my advice for you. If you do not trust me, I might as well die by smashing my head against a pillar." He then stood up and rushed toward the pillar.
Seeing that Li Zuochē was willing to risk his life to prove his loyalty, Xiang Yu believed him and immediately stopped him.
summary_zh: 项羽怀疑李左车是韩信派来的卧底，李左车为表忠心假装撞柱自尽，项羽见状信服并将其拦下。

page_text_ocr_zh:
韩信派人四处张贴榜文，
扬言要在垓下消灭楚军。项羽
气得咬牙切齿，下令立刻出兵。
虞子期和周兰连忙劝阻：
“刘邦狡诈，韩信多谋，大王
如果此时发兵，正好中了
他们的激将法。援军未到，
按兵不动才是上策。”听了他们的
意见，项羽犹豫了。
李左车见状，立刻上前
劝说：“此时若不发兵，等汉
军攻到彭城脚下，可就错失
进攻的良机了。依我看，大
王如果领兵亲征，就能一举
获胜；万一输了，咱们也可以
退守彭城。这可是两全之策。”
此话正合项羽的心意，
他大喜，传令立刻发兵。
page_text_en:
Han Xin sent people to post notices everywhere, 
announcing that they would destroy the Chu army at Gaixia. Xiang Yu 
was furious, gritting his teeth and ordering an immediate advance.
Yu Zi Qi and Zhou Lan hurriedly advised: 
"Liu Bang is deceitful, Han Xin is cunning. If Your Majesty 
launches an attack now, it will exactly fall into 
their provocation tactic. With reinforcements not yet arrived, 
holding back is the best strategy." After hearing their 
advice, Xiang Yu hesitated.
Li Zuoche, seeing this, stepped forward 
and urged: "If we don't act now, by the time the Han army 
reaches the foot of Pengcheng, we will have missed 
the perfect opportunity to strike. In my opinion, if Your Majesty 
leads the troops personally, we can win decisively; even if we lose, 
we can still retreat to Pengcheng. This is a perfect solution for all." 
These words perfectly matched Xiang Yu's thoughts.
He was delighted and immediately ordered the troops to march.
summary_zh: 韩信在垓下张贴榜文挑衅，项羽欲出兵，虞子期和周兰劝阻，认为是激将法；李左车则建议立即出兵，以攻为守，项羽听后大喜，下令发兵。

page_text_ocr_zh:
虞子期见劝不住项羽，
只好向他最宠爱的妃子虞姬
求助。虞姬也担心项羽中计，
等项羽回宫后，她旁敲侧击
地劝项羽不要发兵。然而，
项羽根本听不进虞姬的
好言相劝。他还让虞姬随
他一同出征，亲眼见证他如
何歼灭汉军。
page_text_en:
Yu Ziqi, seeing that he couldn't persuade Xiang Yu,
only turned to his most beloved concubine, Yu Ji,
for help. Yu Ji was also worried that Xiang Yu might fall into a trap.
After Xiang Yu returned to the palace, she subtly
advised him not to send out troops. However,
Xiang Yu simply wouldn't listen to Yu Ji's
kind advice. He even asked Yu Ji to accompany him
on the campaign, to witness with her own eyes
how he would crush the Han army.
summary_zh: 虞子期劝阻项羽未果，转而向虞姬求助。虞姬劝项羽勿发兵，但项羽不听，反而让虞姬随军出征，亲眼见证他歼灭汉军。

page_text_ocr_zh:
临行前，突然刮起一阵狂风，飘扬的军旗拦腰折断，项羽的乌骓马也焦躁地嘶鸣。看到这不祥的征兆，众人都劝项羽撤兵。唯独李左车坚持说项羽不要错失良机。
最后，项羽听从了李左车的建议。大军浩浩荡荡地出发了。李左车见任务完成，半道上偷偷地溜回汉营报告消息。项羽率军来到沛郡安营扎寨，这时才发现李左车不见了。他如梦初醒，明白中计了！但事已至此，他只能奋勇迎敌。
page_text_en:
Before departure, a sudden fierce wind blew, snapping the fluttering military banner in half, and Xiang Yu's black steed neighed anxiously. Seeing this ominous sign, everyone urged Xiang Yu to retreat. Only Li Zuoche insisted that Xiang Yu should not miss this opportunity.
Finally, Xiang Yu followed Li Zuoche's advice. The army set off in grand procession. After completing his mission, Li Zuoche secretly slipped back to Han's camp to report the news. When Xiang Yu's army arrived at Pei Commandery and set up camp, he suddenly realized Li Zuoche was gone. He awoke from his dream, realizing he had been tricked! But with things already done, he could only bravely face the enemy.
summary_zh: 项羽在出征前遭遇不祥征兆，但听从李左车建议率军出发。李左车趁机返回汉营报信，项羽安营后发现被骗，虽懊悔但只能奋勇迎敌。

page_text_ocr_zh:
楚汉两军对峙。刘邦一身戎装，在阵前笑盈盈地问候项羽：“霸王，别来无恙？”
项羽一见刘邦，气不打一处来：“刘邦，你毁约在先，又设计骗我，先前我免你一死，今日必取你命！
刘邦大笑：“我与你斗智不斗勇，今日一战，恐怕死无葬身之地的人是你吧！”
“满嘴胡言，看枪！”项羽提枪冲入汉军，众将士也呐喊着冲锋陷阵。一时间，刀戈争鸣，楚汉两军杀得难解难分。
page_text_en:
The armies of Chu and Han faced off. Liu Bang, in full military attire, cheerfully greeted Xiang Yu at the front: "King of Chu, how have you been?"
Xiang Yu, upon seeing Liu Bang, was furious: "Liu Bang, you broke your promise first and then tricked me. I spared your life before, but today I will surely take your life!"
Liu Bang laughed: "I compete with you in wit, not in bravery. Today's battle will likely end with you having no place to bury your body!"
"Nonsense! Take this spear!" Xiang Yu charged into the Han army, and his soldiers shouted as they advanced. In an instant, weapons clashed, and the armies of Chu and Han fought fiercely, unable to separate.
summary_zh: 楚汉两军在战场上对峙，刘邦与项羽互相挑衅，项羽率军冲锋，双方展开激烈交战。

page_text_ocr_zh:
几个回合后，刘邦领着汉军朝九里山逃去。
项羽乘胜追击，来到山口。项伯见山内烟尘弥漫，
连声高呼：“小心埋伏，小心埋伏！”项羽仔细查看
山内情形，果真像有埋伏，于是传令收兵。
page_text_en:
After several rounds, Liu Bang led the Han army in retreat toward Jiulishan.
Xiang Yu pursued victoriously to the mountain pass. Xiang Bo saw smoke and dust swirling inside the mountain,
and cried out repeatedly: "Beware of an ambush, beware of an ambush!" Xiang Yu carefully examined
the situation inside the mountain, and indeed, it seemed there was an ambush, so he ordered his troops to withdraw.
summary_zh: 项羽追击刘邦至九里山，项伯发现山内烟尘弥漫，提醒有埋伏，项羽查看后确认危险，遂下令收兵。

page_text_ocr_zh:
就在这时，
李左车出现在山顶，劝项羽投降。
项羽恨得牙痒痒，想也不想就
率领大军冲进了山口。

韩信早就等
在那里！顿时，战鼓齐鸣，万箭
齐发，汉军像潮水般涌来。项
羽率楚军奋力拼杀，可是寡不敌众。
没过多久，楚军就被杀得丢盔弃甲，
项羽也在部下的护卫下逃回营地。
page_text_en:
At this moment,
Li Zuoche appeared at the mountain top, urging Xiang Yu to surrender.
Xiang Yu was furious, and without hesitation,
led his army into the mountain pass.

Han Xin had been waiting
there all along! Suddenly, war drums beat, arrows flew in all directions,
and the Han army surged forward like a tide. Xiang Yu led the Chu army in fierce combat,
but they were outnumbered and overwhelmed.
In no time, the Chu army was routed, losing helmets and armor,
and Xiang Yu retreated to his camp under the protection of his subordinates.
summary_zh: 项羽中计冲入山口，韩信早已设下埋伏，万箭齐发，楚军大败，项羽在部下护卫下逃回营地。

page_text_ocr_zh: 虞姬见项羽负伤而归，知道大事不好。她安慰道：“胜败乃是兵家常事，大王不必多虑。”项羽忧虑地说：“唉，刘邦把我们团团包围，我军出多吉少啊！”“那我们就坚守阵地，等待援军。”说完，虞姬端出美酒。项羽痛饮了几杯，又困又累，不一会儿便睡着了。虞姬却睡不着，她走出帐外。
page_text_en: Yu Ji saw Xiang Yu return wounded and knew something was wrong. She comforted him: "Victory and defeat are common in warfare, Your Majesty need not worry." Xiang Yu worriedly said: "Alas, Liu Bang has surrounded us completely, our army's chances are slim!" "Then let's hold our ground and wait for reinforcements." After saying this, Yu Ji brought out fine wine. Xiang Yu drank several cups, then, tired and weary, fell asleep shortly after. Yu Ji, however, couldn't sleep, so she stepped out of the tent.
summary_zh: 项羽负伤归来，虞姬安慰他并端出美酒，项羽饮后入睡，虞姬则独自走出帐外，神情忧虑。

page_text_ocr_zh:
月色清明，凉风徐徐，歌声隐隐：“四面楚歌胡不归，千里从军为了谁……”
虞姬很诧异，这是楚歌呀！四周都被汉军包围，怎么会有人唱楚歌呢？歌声越来越清晰，营地里的士兵们也听见了。一时间，楚军人心动摇。
page_text_en:
The moonlight was clear, the cool breeze gentle, and faint singing could be heard: "Four sides of Chu songs, why don't you return? A thousand miles of military service, for whom...?"
Yuji was very surprised. That was the Chu song! Surrounded by Han troops on all sides, how could anyone be singing the Chu song? The singing grew clearer and clearer, and the soldiers in the camp began to hear it too. In an instant, the Chu army's morale began to waver.
summary_zh: 月夜下，楚营中传来《四面楚歌》，虞姬感到诧异，士兵们听见歌声后军心动摇。

page_text_ocr_zh: 虞姬连忙奔回军帐，摇醒项羽。项羽听见四面楚歌，悲叹道：“唉，刘邦一定已夺得楚地，大势已去，大势已去啊！”虞姬安慰道：“大王，您只是一时失利，千万不要灰心，等江东的援军一到，您就可以奋力突围了。”“军心已散，再战谈何容易啊！”项羽悲愤地喝道：“力拔山兮气盖世，时不利兮骓不逝。骓不逝兮可奈何，虞兮虞兮奈若何！”
page_text_en: Yu Ji hurried back to the military tent and shook Xiang Yu awake. Xiang Yu, hearing the 'Four-Sided Chu Song,' lamented, "Alas, Liu Bang must have already seized the Chu territories. The situation is lost, lost indeed!" Yu Ji comforted him, "Your Majesty, you've only suffered a temporary setback. Don't lose heart. Once the reinforcements from Jiangdong arrive, you can fight your way out." "The troops' morale is shattered; how can we possibly fight again?" Xiang Yu cried bitterly, "I could pull mountains apart, my spirit surpassed the world, but now the times are against me, and my steed won't advance. My steed won't advance—what can I do? Yu, Yu, what can I do with you?"
summary_zh: 虞姬唤醒项羽，告知四面楚歌，项羽悲叹大势已去，虞姬劝其勿灰心，项羽则悲愤吟唱《垓下歌》。

page_text_ocr_zh: “大王，不如我歌一曲，为您解忧吧。”虞姬强作镇定，取剑起舞。
page_text_en: "Your Majesty, let me sing and dance a piece to ease your worries," Yu Ji said, forcing calm, and drew her sword to dance.
summary_zh: 虞姬为安慰项羽，强作镇定，持剑起舞，试图以歌舞解其忧愁。

page_text_ocr_zh:
汉军从四面杀过来了。项羽下令分头迎敌。他拉起虞姬，要带她一起突围。虞姬推开项羽：“臣妾怎能拖累大王！我愿自刎于君前。请大王不要有任何牵挂，全力突围！”
说时迟那时快，虞姬剑锋一转，殷红的鲜血染满罗裙。项羽强忍悲痛，带领将士杀出重围，一路逃到乌江边。
page_text_en:
The Han army surged in from all sides. Xiang Yu ordered his troops to fight back in separate groups. He pulled up Yuji, intending to take her with him to break through the encirclement. Yuji pushed him away: "How could I burden the King? I am willing to die before you. Please, Your Majesty, do not let any worries hold you back—fight with all your might to break through!"
Too late, too fast—Yuji turned her sword, and crimson blood stained her silk skirt. Xiang Yu, enduring his grief, led his soldiers through the encirclement and fled all the way to the banks of the Wu River.
summary_zh: 虞姬为不拖累项羽，自刎于他面前，项羽强忍悲痛，带领将士突围至乌江边。

page_text_ocr_zh: 项羽在江边驻步不前，他环顾四周，仰天长叹：“将士们都战死了，我实在没脸回去见江东父老啊！”说完，拔剑自刎。无人的岸边，只剩烟波浩渺的乌江水滔滔流向远方。
page_text_en: Xiang Yu stood motionless by the riverbank, looking around and sighing to the sky: "All my soldiers are dead; I have no face to return to my people in Jiangdong!" He then drew his sword and took his own life. On the deserted shore, only the vast, misty waters of the Wu River flowed endlessly into the distance.
summary_zh: 项羽在乌江边悲叹无颜见江东父老，最终拔剑自刎，江水滔滔，无人见证其最后时刻。
深蓝色夜空中，一弯新月被黄色与绿色的花枝环绕，画面宁静而富有诗意，无文字内容。
